ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for EOL EdM and CAS students whose cohort began Sum 2008. The course begins Aug 27 and ends Nov 12. Class sessions will be held at the Oak Brook, Multi-University Center on the following Wednesday evenings from 5:30 to 9:30 PM: Aug 27, Sep 3, Sep 17, Sep 24, Oct 8, Oct 15, Oct 22, Oct 29, and Nov 11. Students will also meet at the Oak Brook facility on Friday, Oct 24 from 5:30 to 9:30 PM and on Saturday, Oct 25 from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The class WILL NOT meet on the following three Wednesday evenings: Sep 10, Oct 1 and Nov 5.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $441.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
